cases.claim: “Before preventing migraine with QULIPTA, it was hard keeping plans.” | “QULIPTA MORE ZERO-MIGRAINE DAYS POSSIBLE.” | “QULIPTA-the forget you-get migraine medicine.”

cases.rationale: Creates impression of total migraine prevention.
cases.check: Judge: 'zero-migraine'/'forget you get migraine' framing vs MMD reduction of ~1–2 days.
